sar.narrative: Between 2016-11-21 20:00 and 2016-11-21 20:30, card C07297-K1 held by customer C07297 was used for 4 transaction(s) totalling $1,906.07: 3476602 ($478.95, online), 3476633 ($456.96, online), 3476665 ($488.04, online), 3476682 ($482.12, online). The investigation was opened on 2016-11-22 after a customer report: "Customer C07297 message: 'I never made this $482.12 purchase. Please check my card.' Refers to 3476682." The purchases were made online from device profile(s) Trident/7.0 | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1920x1080, iOS Device | iOS 11.2.1 | mobile safari 11.0 | 2208x1242. The cardholder, when contacted, stated they did not make the purchases and still holds the card (response simulated per policy section 5). Repeated online purchases priced just under $500 in a sub-hour burst, from devices new to the account, one behind a transparent proxy. The amounts appear chosen to stay under a $500 authorization threshold. Found by windowing the card's timeline and matching the burst shape to confirmed closed cases CC-3748, CC-3841 and CC-3907. The activity matches previously confirmed bank cases CC-4124, CC-4086, CC-3907. This is suspicious because undocumented coordinated pattern, and the activity is inconsistent with the cardholder's history. Total suspicious amount: $1,906.07. The card is recommended for blocking and reissue; connected cards are placed under monitoring.
